description: Implement focused web-owned continuation policy and integrate it with PersonAuth and PersonSessionController. Capture only recognized protected GET/HEAD People pages in protected signed session state; preserve across recoverable OTP failures; consume on successful auth; clear on logout; default to /people/profile. Revalidate before redirect, preserve route authorization and BO session isolation, and generate redirect paths with supported conn script_name prefixes. Action reuse: extend existing auth HTTP flow; local-only route/session implementation detail, no Action/tool exposure or authentication changes.
title: [zaq-ba7] Implement People login continuation
